name: Schluersburg Creek-Femme Osage Creek
about: Schluersburg Creek-Femme Osage Creek drains about 35 square miles, all of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 900 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 470 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Femme Osage Creek, Schluersburg Creek and Becker Branch. Downstream, its water passes through the Femme Osage Creek, Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River and Greens Chute-Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
